```python
import polars as pl

# Create sample long-format DataFrame
df_long = pl.DataFrame({
    "date": ["2024-01-01", "2024-01-01", "2024-01-02", "2024-01-02"],
    "city": ["NYC", "LA", "NYC", "LA"],
    "temperature": [32, 75, 35, 78]
})

# Reshape to wide format
df_wide = df_long.pivot(
    on="city",
    index="date",
    values="temperature"
)

print(df_wide)
```
